game.name: Cabela's Big Game Hunter 2010 (USA)
game.desc: Cabela's Big Game Hunter 2010 is a first-person shooter for Xbox 360. The player takes on the role of a hunter whose goal is very simple: to hunt any type of animal... even protected species. With its sumptuous scenery and ultra-realistic handling of its weapons, the game will be a real treat for all budding hunters.
game.genre: Action, Simulation, Hunting, Hunting and Fishing
